reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: §21.1 imposes a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000, matching the preferred position's basis and floor.

§21.2 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually and preserves data-restoration, replacement-service, notification and incident-response costs as direct damages, so the exclusion is not overbroad against Customer.

§21.3 supplies every required uncapped carve-out (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, infringement of the other Party's IP) and confirms Customer's undisputed Fee obligation is not 'damages' subject to the cap.

'Fees' (§1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is meaningful rather than illusory, and no one-sided or competing cap language is identified in the warranty or indemnity sections.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed; both deterministic checks pass and the rationale is accurate to the quoted paragraphs.
